additional_info.subject: SiD170002134 Curauma Modems error
additional_info.body:
Hi Support,
We are in commissioning in Curauma Chile, where we have update the first SiD to V6, serial MP / R7 170002134, but the modems are working very strange.
Since the v6.0.3-0-g215cb74 has updated, the SiD has worked very strange in the communication.
The Modems are update also when, example we remove the LAN Cable, and connect again the SCB or the OCPP, don’t recover the connection.
We have tested we 2 x VE, Tesla and Audi eTron, parallel, they work good.
In the picture below, if we tray to get the configuration, via SCB not possible.

Hello
Kaushik,
That is correct, the charger was commissioned partially, due to depot was missing the Distribution Power Line, it has energized 400 V, last week.
Now we are checking all charges, and testing with EVs from owner, before to start with other customer EV.
Our idea is update to V6 all of them, but, this charger, number 170002134, effectively works strange with new firmware.
We repeat again the symptoms,
When we remove the LAN Cable, and connect again the SCB or the OCPP, don’t recover the connection. When we do a ping, 104 and 154 don’t respond, look the architecture.
We have tested today 2 x VE, Tesla and Audi eTron, parallel, they work good.
In the picture below, if we try to get the configuration, Router XF3 and XF4, via SCB not possible.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0412075-DC/SiD/CL - [zlusYd] SiD170002134 Curauma Modems error CRM:00796001438
additional_info.body:
Hi Jesus,
So in today's site visit, we have fixed the "SCB router configuration fetch" issue. But we still have 2 topics open.
zlusYd  - IMD_BC4 deactivated for Test purposes > I will discuss this with the experts if they can disable it remotely.
2u3CAt - Charger showing Offline on SCB, but we are getting logs > I suspect there might be a corrupt config file issue. Right now the charger is on v6.0.3, so we can try updating the charger to v6.1.3 via USB, otherwise we need to do the restore config.
Tools required restore_config:
USB drive 32 GB.
Cfast card reader
Companian tool
Siemens Laptop with Admin rights.
Live Linux file (We will send you through SecuFex).
Once you have the tools available, please contact NOC, so they can support you preparing the Live Linux USB for restore config.
Thank you
Best Regards,
Vishal Dhiman
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

Need to check IMD Modbus connections and configuration.
RC will be on site next week,
